text:
tara.sales: Quick ask from MeridianHealth procurement  they need a "minimal assurance pack" to close PO: SOC2 excerpt, ISO scope note, pen-test attestation (signed), redacted staging network diagram, and KMS separation note. Also want to know if Dedicated + customer KMS changes pricing. Need a short reply we can send.
david.sec: We can provide redacted SOC2 control excerpt, ISO scope statement, and a one-page pen-test attestation signed by Security Lead. We dont share full reports.
indra.devops: For scanner access we can provision ephemeral creds + presigned upload (7d TTL). Onprem access requires SOW/legal signoff. Naming conv: `meridian_evidence/<artifact>-YYYYMMDD.pdf`.
mike.eng: I'll produce a redacted network sketch (no internal CIDRs/hostnames) and a KMS separation blurb pulled from our ops playbook. ETA 48h.
tara.sales: Pricing impact?
david.sec: Short: Dedicated + customer-managed KMS typically moves the deal to Enterprise tier (platform fee) + Dedicated commitment; expect a one-time integration effort. Say "subject to RevOps quote."
legal-bot: pen-atto-template.pdf uploaded: https://redwood.internal/evidence/pen-atto-template.pdf (uploader: legal-bot).
tara.sales: Draft reply I'll send: "We can assemble a compact evidence packet (SOC2 excerpt, ISO scope, signed pen-test attestation, redacted network sketch, and KMS separation note) within ~3 business days; pen-test signature may take up to 7 business days for legal sign-off. Enabling Dedicated with customer-managed KMS typically requires Enterprise tier licensing (platform fee), a Dedicated commitment, and a one-time integration charge; we'll confirm pricing with RevOps. For scanner access we can issue ephemeral staging credentials and a presigned upload (7-day TTL). We do not provide full pen-test reports or raw internal logs."
indra.devops: Creating presigned path now; will post masked creds here when ready.
mike.eng: Pushing redacted sketch to presigned bucket once ready, will tag here.
tara.sales: Thanks all  sending to procurement now.
